headline: Fox Corporation Acquires Roku for $22 Billion to Expand Streaming
summary: Fox Corporation announced the acquisition of Roku for $22 billion in a strategic push into streaming, anticipating $400 million in annual cost savings within the first two years.
why: Major media consolidations combine traditional broadcast networks with streaming distribution platforms to capture digital advertising revenue.
